name: calculator-project
description: Full-stack calculator application with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run start:backend:test & npm run start:frontend & sleep 5 && npm run test:playwright
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.coverage: npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend
